question: The automated cooking machine has buttons with cardinal directions like "EAST". Are those for the seasonings of the different regions of the world? What kind of flavoring do they use?
answer: Actually, you'll notice that there are a bunch of circular buttons to the sides, but not enough for all 500 dishes the machine can make. That's because when you press "EAST", they all change images to dishes from the East Blue. If you press "WEST", "SOUTH", or "NORTH", the buttons will change to different sets of food. And this machine of dreams can make them all!
name: Yoshida
